ConfigCat — feature flags

configcat/flags · version 1

envs add configcat/flags

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
CONFIGCAT_SDK_KEY required config One key, used the same way by browser, mobile and server SDKs: ConfigCat has no client and server split at all. Public here because its own documentation has frontend applications download the config with this key. The name is convention.. where to get it
